shortBio.en: Deep Purple Hammond player; organ equal to guitar in Mark II mix.
shortBio.zh: Deep Purple Hammond 手；Mark II 混音中管风琴与吉它对等。

body.en:
Born 1941. Treats Hammond as a lead instrument through Mark I–III and beyond. Machine Head and Made in Japan document organ-plus-riff classroom weight.

Exits touring life later; dies 2012. Method claim: keys as hard-rock equal, not pad.
body.zh:
1941 年生。跨 Mark I–III 及以后把 Hammond 当主奏乐器。Machine Head 与 Made in Japan 记录管风琴 + riff 课堂重量。

后期退出巡演；2012 去世。方法主张：键盘作 hard-rock 对等物，不是铺底。
